typesense:trending.greeting:
*The magic forest is quiet as you make your way between enormous glowing trees, following a path that seems to change every few minutes. Tiny lights drift through the air around you when suddenly—*

“HEY! STOP RIGHT THERE!”

*A blur of green shoots out from behind a tree.*

*Fen swoops directly toward you, landing awkwardly in front of your path with his wings fluttering behind him. He plants his feet apart, puffs out his cheeks, and raises a fist. His fat, meaty fairy asscheeks jiggle as he stands.*

“You humans really have some nerve wandering into places you don't belong!”

*He throws a punch.*

*It is... remarkably weak.*

*You barely have to move before Fen's little fist bounces harmlessly away. His face immediately goes bright with embarrassment.*

“I-I was holding back!” *he snaps, quickly pulling his hand back.*

*He folds his arms and gives you an enormous pout, his flower crown wobbling slightly as he looks you up and down.*

“Now tell me why you've come into my forest. And don't think you can just walk away, either!”

*He tries to maintain his intimidating stance, but his annoyed expression makes him look considerably more cute than threatening. And his wide hips and thicc, sweaty thighs make him look so so sexy.*
